98048689.s: Discover the Black Gold Museum in Riyadh, an engaging interactive experience that presents the history of oil and its global impact in an educational and artistic way across four floors. The Black Gold Museum is located near King Khalid International Airport in Riyadh. Across four floors, it presents the relationship between people and oil in a professional artistic style, from the formation and discovery of oil to its extraction and its uses across industries throughout history. The museum relies on artistic models and creative visual designs to tell the positive and negative story of oil without bias, with a free guided tour that enriches the visit.

Juniper wood, granite and stained glass were used in its construction, giving it a distinctive aesthetic character that reflects the taste of that era. Its exterior remains attractive to visitors and to photographers interested in old architecture.

98048578.s: A fertile valley in Taif with a mild climate and green scenery, and an ideal place to enjoy the beauty of nature and fresh air. Wadi Qarn is a historic valley whose name dates back to the pre-Islamic era, and it is mentioned in ancient Arabic poetry in the stories of the Banu Fahm tribe. The valley is known for its mild climate and refreshing green scenery, with wild aromatic plants that add to its special beauty, along with an old ancient dam at the top of the valley. It is a favorite destination for hikers and nature explorers, but visitors are advised to keep the site clean because of the litter that has built up in some areas.
